name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A modal window built on the native <dialog> element, with enter and exit transitions.

classes.name: dialog
classes.description: The dialog box. Put it on a <dialog>.

classes.name: dialog__footer
classes.description: Shaded footer that bleeds to the dialog edges. Place it last inside dialog__content.

classes.name: dialog__close
classes.description: Positions a close button in the top corner.

variables.name: --dialog-size
variables.description: Maximum width on screens 40rem and wider.

attributes.name: commandfor / command
attributes.description: Native invoker commands open and close the dialog with no JavaScript: command="show-modal" to open and command="close" to close, with commandfor set to the dialog id.

attributes.name: data-dialog
attributes.description: Enables the dialog behavior. Only needed for the actions below.

attributes.name: data-dialog-action
attributes.description: e.g. "click->closeOnClickOutside" on the dialog closes it when the backdrop is clicked.

actions.name: show
actions.description: Opens the dialog without a backdrop (non-modal).

actions.name: showModal
actions.description: Opens the dialog as a modal.

actions.name: closeOnClickOutside
actions.description: Closes the dialog when the click landed on the <dialog> element itself, which is the backdrop area.

notes: Page scrolling is locked while a modal dialog is open (see reset.css).
Browsers without invoker commands can open the dialog with dialog.showModal() from your own script.

examples.title: Alert dialog
examples.description: No close button and no click-outside: the user must choose.
